subject.title: feat(agents): add stable A2A session metadata

question: Should A2A prompts expose both stable agent IDs and canonical conversation scope in addition to the configured requester identity proposed by the related fix?
rationale: These fields establish durable model-visible behavior across every A2A phase and overlap a separate identity fix, so code review cannot safely choose the permanent vocabulary or sequencing.

options.title: Consolidate one metadata contract
options.body: Define agent ID, configured identity name, and owner-prepared scope together, then land one coordinated prompt shape across initial, reply, and announce contexts.

options.title: Limit this PR to agent IDs
options.body: Drop inferred scope labels, retain only stable parsed agent IDs, and let the related requester-identity work add the human-readable name separately.

options.title: Pause this feature
options.body: Keep the existing placeholders and channel lines until maintainers decide that additional model-visible A2A metadata is needed.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one metadata contract
recommendation.body: Define agent ID, configured identity name, and owner-prepared scope together, then land one coordinated prompt shape across initial, reply, and announce contexts.

likelyOwner.reason: This shared agent-runtime prompt contract needs project-level product and architecture ownership.
